title: Act: Author the-boys-room world and bedroom YAML
description: Write the declarative content matching the runtime types.
acceptance_criteria: Given the YAML, when loaded, then it matches SceneDef and WorldDef.
Given the bookshelf, when searched, then secret_door_open is set.

steps.action: Create world.yaml with id the-boys-room, title "The Boy's Room", startScene bedroom, scenes [bedroom], characters [{id: boy, name: The Boy}], flags [secret_door_open, computer_on].

Create bedroom.yaml with id bedroom, openingDialogue intro, dialogue node intro (speaker boy, text "I don't know what to do next. What should we do?", choices: 'Look around the room' next null, 'Let's explore' next null); objects: bed, bookshelf (openWhenFlag secret_door_open; actions inspect, push, search with search events [set_flag secret_door_open true, show_text 'A hidden door swings open behind the books.'], leave), desk, old-computer (inspect, search with set_flag computer_on), window, door (inspect, leave). Each object has name, description and at least an inspect action with show_text.
steps.code:
id: bedroom
openingDialogue: intro
dialogue:
  - id: intro
    speaker: boy
    text: "I don't know what to do next. What should we do?"
    choices:
      - text: Look around the room
      - text: Let's explore
steps.expected: validateWorld returns [] for the loaded content.
